notes: Diagnostic only: gainQualified, installable, productionPerformanceClaim and busyTimeClaim are always false; no artifact, installation, promotion, default or candidate change.

Sampled path: the incumbent OFF arm only (control preparation, declared modern candidate with par64 and router launch divisor 1, installed v1 E4R32, Q4 width 32, CPU FP64 routing). Stage sampling refuses to start or dispatch inside the router overlap, device routing or route capture scopes; no existing guard was changed.

Encoder topology changes while sampling: every deferred dispatch gets its own serial compute encoder inside the SAME command buffer; kernels, order, bindings, command buffers, commits and waits are unchanged. Sampled intervals and the sampled-minus-plain wall overhead describe this changed topology, not the unmodified baseline cost.

Per fixture: fresh direct reference, a plain OFF run, then the same OFF run with stage sampling on the 31 continuation calls (prefill is not sampled). Both runs need the 32 frozen IDs on the previous actual argmax, 32 full-vocabulary finite outputs, exact derived counters, pinned 1349 kernels and 37 command buffers per continuation and vector and per-element normalized < 1e-4 against the reference; the sampled run must equal the plain run in Float.bitPattern at every logit with identical totals.

Per sampled continuation: one encoder per counted kernel, one sampled command buffer per submitted command buffer, exact kernel-name counts against the runner's own counters, two resolved samples per encoder with no counter error value, no zero, no end before start, all later than the previous token, and two identical resolves. Any failure poisons the sample buffer, which is then never reused.

Encoder intervals are raw stage ticks: not GPU busy time, utilization, bandwidth or recoverable time. Shares are ratios of disjoint sampled stage intervals and are omitted when adjacent encoders overlap. CPU wall times are profile overhead diagnostics, not TPOT.
Model SHA-256 is the cached explicit-refresh record; nothing here hashes, re-verifies or downloads the model. No weights, scales or coefficients enter the report.
